description: An envelope shaped like a thrown object's flight, rising and falling as a parabola and able to bounce

params.text: Sets how hard the shot is thrown, which sets how long the flight lasts
Attenuates the voltage at the jack beside it before it is added to the impulse knob
Sets how steeply the shot is thrown, from nearly flat at the bottom to nearly vertical at the top
Attenuates the voltage at the jack beside it before it is added to the angle knob
Sets how hard the shot is pulled back down, which is what curves the flight
Attenuates the voltage at the jack beside it before it is added to the gravity knob
Fires a shot, and holding it down keeps firing a fresh one every sample
Sets how much of the angle is kept on each bounce, so low settings make the bounces die away quickly
Attenuates the voltage at the jack beside it before it is added to the bounce knob
Switched on, the shot bounces when it lands instead of stopping

inputs.text: Modulates the impulse through the small knob beside it
Modulates the angle through the small knob beside it
Modulates the gravity through the small knob beside it
Modulates the bounce through the small knob beside it
Any voltage other than zero here fires a shot, and a voltage held high keeps firing fresh ones

outputs.text: Carries the flight as an audio signal, -5V to 5V, with the sign flipping on alternate bounces so the bounces read as a waveform
Carries the flight as a control voltage, 0V to 10V, the ordinary envelope output
Sends a 10ms pulse at 10V when a shot is fired and again each time the flight comes back to zero

notes: nothing happens until a shot is fired, by the shoot button or by a voltage at the trigger jack
the four setting knobs are read only while a flight is under way; turning one between shots changes nothing until the next shot starts
with bounce switched on the flight keeps rebounding for up to sixteen thousand bounces before it gives up, which at low bounce settings is a long tail of very short hops
